new_releases.title: New Releases
new_releases.description: Catch up on new releases from the past few years.

621679.description: When Washington Post journalist Jamal Khashoggi disappears, his fiancée and dissidents worldwide piece together clues to his murder and the cover-up.
621679.title: The Dissident

692134.description: An agent is subjected to alien experimentation and wakes up 300 years into the future. With Earth now destroyed, he is the only hope for mankind.
692134.title: The Prototype

723572.description: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County, where his next victims, a teenage girl and her brother, await.
723572.title: Terrifier 2

100002833.description: A Korean-American family moves to a farm in search of their own American Dream, finding hope and a new home.
100002833.title: Minari

100002844.description: A Detroit waitress is seduced into a weekend of stripping in Florida in this dazzling saga based on the greatest Twitter story ever told.
100002844.title: Zola

100010166.description: A drifter is tricked into a janitorial job at an amusement park, where the mundane tasks become a fight for survival against demonic animatronics.
100010166.title: Willy's Wonderland

100010492.description: Tasked with finding a new planet, a group of astronauts set off into deep space, where their mission descends into chaos and paranoia.
100010492.title: Voyagers

100010926.description: A desperate young girl and her little brother stumble upon a nexus of terrifying evil when they venture into a dark wood in search of food and work.
100010926.title: Gretel & Hansel

100011065.description: A suburban housewife and her bestie transform a pastime of coupon clipping into an elaborate counterfeit operation worth millions of dollars.
100011065.title: Queenpins

100013787.description: During a psychiatric evaluation, a convicted killer on death row claims he’s a demon and insists that the doctor will commit three murders of his own.
100013787.title: Nefarious

100014417.description: A deadly assassin is forced to fight for her life against the black ops organization she works for after asking questions and breaking protocol.
100014417.title: Ava

100015231.description: Four friends, all high school teachers, test a theory that they will improve their lives by maintaining a constant level of alcohol in their blood.
100015231.title: Another Round

100015463.description: A head chef attempts to get through a night of service while dealing with personal issues, a former boss, and a newly lowered health rating.
100015463.title: Boiling Point

100015807.description: An elite assassin, who uses technology to possess brains, finds that the tables have turned, trapping her in a mind that threatens her obliteration.
100015807.title: Possessor

100016494.description: Bosnia, 1995. When the Serbian army takes over her town, a UN translator becomes a conduit for crucial negotiations as her community seeks shelter.
100016494.title: Quo Vadis, Aida?

100024704.description: A fictional account of one night where American icons gathered to discuss their roles in the Civil Rights Movement and cultural upheaval of the 1960s.
100024704.title: One Night in Miami…

100026183.description: After being involuntarily discharged from the U.S. Army, James Reed joins a paramilitary organization in order to support his family.
100026183.title: The Contractor

100028922.description: Diagnosed with a mental illness, an introspective teen falls in love with a brilliant classmate who inspires him to open his heart.
100028922.title: Words on Bathroom Walls

100029486.description: A girl with dreams of an education finds herself fighting to survive a catastrophe in her village in 1948 Palestine. Inspired by true events.
100029486.title: Farha

100029674.description: After escaping a mysterious man's cabin, Jessica finds herself in the wilderness, relying only on her wits for survival as her pursuer closes in.
100029674.title: Alone

100032619.description: Tim Jenkin and Stephen Lee, two white South Africans labeled as terrorists, make a daring escape from Pretoria Maximum Security Prison.
100032619.title: Escape From Pretoria

100033333.description: With a titanium plate surgically fused to her skull, Alexia embarks on a wild journey that questions our assumptions about family, identity, and love.
100033333.title: Titane

100034384.description: A young boy embarks on a journey to find out if the mythic hero who disappeared from his neighborhood two decades ago still lives.
100034384.title: Samaritan

100035031.description: After Christopher Robin abandons them for college, Pooh and Piglet embark on a bloody rampage as they search for a new source of food.
100035031.title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey

100035725.description: Mikey Saber, a charismatic con man and washed-up porn star, plots his return to the big time from small-town Texas in this story of an American hustler and a hometown that barely tolerates him.
100035725.title: Red Rocket

100039863.description: A garbage man tormented by his past pursues a quiet life of redemption until a crime boss makes him face the deeds he’s desperate to leave behind.
100039863.title: Clean

100039932.description: Six friends hire a medium to conduct a séance via Zoom and inadvertently invite a demonic presence to cross over, putting them all in grave danger.
100039932.title: Host

100039938.description: A federal agent returns to his hometown after twenty years to attend a funeral and reopens the investigation into the death of a teenage girl.
100039938.title: The Dry

100039941.description: After moving to Bucharest with her husband, a young actress notices a mysterious stranger watching her from an apartment window across the way.
100039941.title: Watcher

100040120.description: Kurt is a rideshare driver desperate for social media attention and will stop at nothing to go viral, including livestreaming a deadly rampage.
100040120.title: Spree

100040148.description: A Danish family visits a Dutch family they met on holiday, but as time passes, the idyllic reunion unravels into one of unspeakable horror.
100040148.title: Speak No Evil

100040298.description: A young woman battles indecision, navigating turbulent waters of love and career to discover her true path and find where her heart belongs.
100040298.title: The Worst Person in the World

100041123.description: After his mission is exposed, a CIA operative and his Afghan translator must escape hostile territory to reach extraction in Kandahar.
100041123.title: Kandahar

100041606.description: A string of chance encounters lead a local punk rocker on the lam into the home of his biggest fan for a vengeance-fueled adventure about town.
100041606.title: Dinner in America

100044105.description: A brilliant engineering student is recruited by a team of master thieves to help steal a stash of treasure locked in an impenetrable bank vault.
100044105.title: The Vault

100044223.description: A rancher on the Arizona border becomes the unlikely defender of a Mexican boy desperately fleeing cartel assassins who've pursued him into the U.S.
100044223.title: The Marksman

100046087.description: A film following Arjun, a man with no memory who escapes from a Pakistani prison and returns to India to uncover his true identity.
100046087.title: Martin

100046649.description: In her complicated relationship with Hardin, Tessa confronts a single, difficult choice that holds the power to irrevocably change both their lives.
100046649.title: After We Collided

100046691.description: A WWII pilot carrying top secret documents aboard a B-17 Flying Fortress must battle a sinister presence that threatens everyone on the flight.
100046691.title: Shadow in the Cloud

100047084.description: Sophie reflects on the time spent with her idealistic father on their last vacation, trying to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn’t.
100047084.title: Aftersun

100047776.description: Art the Clown is set to unleash chaos on the unsuspecting residents of Miles County as they peacefully drift off to sleep on Christmas Eve.
100047776.title: Terrifier 3

100048158.description: Four friends, all high school teachers, test a theory that they will improve their lives by maintaining a constant level of alcohol in their blood.
100048158.title: Another Round

100048358.description: When Nazis steal his gold, a relentless ex-commando becomes a one-man army, stopping at nothing to reclaim his treasure and destroy his enemies
100048358.title: Sisu

0300015980.description: An animated comedy centered on a suave spy, Sterling Archer, and his zany and misguided cohorts, who attempt to rid the world of evil.
0300015980.title: Archer

0300014168.description: Based on a best-selling series, an intelligent but socially withdrawn young man finds himself admitted to a very secret, exclusive college of magic.
0300014168.title: The Magicians

0300015678.description: Follows the Pearson family through decades and three generations, touching upon their triumphs, struggles, loves, losses, and more.
0300015678.title: This Is Us

0300011089.description: A hip-hop mogul looks to his three sons for a successor while dealing with his formidable ex-wife, who attempts to reclaim her spot in the empire.
0300011089.title: Empire

0300015593.description: In this award-winning legal thriller, a quick-witted law professor and criminal defense attorney involves five of her students in a murder plot.
0300015593.title: How to Get Away With Murder

0300014418.description: In this series that topples the typical spy-action thriller, two fiercely intelligent women go head to head in an epic game of cat and mouse.
0300014418.title: Killing Eve

0300004985.description: A married veteran Detective Chief Inspector and his young sergeant investigate murders in the quaint, quirky villages of England’s Midsomer County.
0300004985.title: Midsomer Murders
